main_text.l: ex iis intellexi, te ad iter Parisiense ac-
salvus & incolumis; priores tuas literas acc-
si fiat, liber Esther simul cum libro Ba-
ruch esset ex isto codice exscribendus.
habes aut recuperare potes, non erit inu-
deferre, quod ad varias illas lectiones, quæ a-
describendi otium tibi aut nullum erit,
aut bene admodum commodius est ut
tecum deferas, postquàm hic in lucem
editæ fuerint, illas Romam rediens tecum
Cardinalis Pallotus, hæc enim unde accepta
mum virum D. le Jay tuo nomine saluta-vi,

page.notes: The line-end mark after "saluta" (printed as a small stroke, likely a hyphen) is doubtful; transcribed as a hyphen. "continua-" is a catchword at the foot, so it is also printed at the end of the last line in the text as a word broken at the line end. Printed "qv" forms (qvæcunqve, qvàm) changed to u per the u/v rule. Printed "saluta" line-end mark not otherwise verified.
